text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) reiterates its commitment to pollution reduction.
- Canadian exports to Kuwait amount to $125 million, Royal Bank of Canada official says.
- Three gunmen abduct man with 13,000 dinars ($42,763) from local bank.
- Bourse officials from Kuwait, Egypt and Lebanon to meet on Thursday in Cairo.
- Court of Appeals rules that Education Ministry should pay housing allowances to 1,000 teachers.
- Interior ministry official says ministry could ban motorists from using mobile telephones.
